_README: Optional, LOCAL-ONLY maintainer scan patterns for the public guard test
template; copy it to tests/private_patterns.local.json (gitignored via
*.local.json) and fill in your own private tokens. The public test loads
the .local.json if present and SKIPS the private-pattern checks if absent,
so no maintainer-private strings ever ship in the public repo.
Each check has two lists of regex alternatives:
lowercase prose is legitimate and must not false-positive).
Both lists are OR-joined and scanned across the public surface (scripts/,
tests/, all of .claude/, docs/index.html, and the root onboarding docs).
A hit fails the test. Leave both lists empty to disable a check.
